fields.notes:
A devotee of Lord Caitanya, a Kāyastha of north Rāḍha and the eldest brother of Vāsudeva Ghoṣa. He led a family life; his descendants belong to the royal family of Dinājpur (see «Vāsudeva Ghoṣa»).

The record also held Kaṁsāri Miśra (cousin of Lord Gaurāṅga) and Kaṁsāri Sena (of Nityānanda's branch), now in records of their own; the record «Kansari Ghosh» #671 was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
